refreshNote: The canonical copy is the hypercurrent file named in backendSource. When a case changes there, copy the file verbatim into revenium-python-sdk-internal tests/fixtures/ and revenium-middleware-go-internal core/enforcement/testdata/, add sourceCommit naming the hypercurrent commit it was copied from, and run each repo's department call-scope test.
description: A department cap's verdict names a person; the cap's other filter rows decide which of that person's calls it covers. Each case is a compiled payload as the backend serves it, one call, and whether that call is blocked (and by which rule). The call fields are: subscriberEmail, provider, model, agent, taskType, productName, organizationName, credentialName, credentialValue (the raw credential, sent without a name). Absent means the call does not carry it.
knownDivergence: Dated model spellings (gpt-4o vs gpt-4o-2024-08-06) are folded by the Python SDK, by Go only when the served model may be dated, and never by metering; no case here depends on them.
A call whose provider or model the SDK was not told keeps the cap applying in the Python SDK; metering always knows both, so no case here leaves them out.
A candidate whose rule window has ended is skipped by the Python SDK, as its single-slot and ordinary rules already are; the Go SDK and metering do not skip it, and no case here has an ended window.
